purpose: Search for a description by offering two imperfect labels.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain expression + というか … + というか
It was a strange sound, mysterious or perhaps eerie.
Cautious or perhaps timid, he did not move.
Happy or perhaps relieved, I began to cry.
formation: Plain expression + というか … + というか
restrictions: Often followed by a summarizing evaluation.
mistake: This paired use signals difficulty describing something, not necessarily a correction.
